assessment: Synthetic observations motivate separate selection and placement hypotheses, without establishing causes. Combined timing and overlapping widths do not isolate insertion or dimensional tolerance.

openings.claim: Adapt double-entry bookkeeping: reconcile an accepted-order ledger of shapes, quantities and exterior color against parts staged on a reusable outlined board before assembly.
openings.delta: Accounting obligations map to required components; reconciliation maps to matching each shape and quantity. Failed correspondence: balanced totals can conceal wrong partitions. Changed material assumptions: physical identities require silhouettes and inspection; verify ledgers against existing templates. Shared bins feed a bounded staging area per order.
openings.prediction: If selection interference contributes, reconciliation reduces mismatches most in mixed-layout orders; unchanged insertion time would distinguish this from improved fit.
openings.probe: Use ten reusable sample sets in paired incumbent/staged trials, alternating worker and method order. Independently inventory contents and time selection, insertion, checking and packing. Include an equal-count wrong-shape substitution and uncommon colors; price setup and consumables.
assumptions: Staging fits the single bench and fixed schedule.
Verified order ledgers are accurate; costs remain within both caps.

openings.claim: Adapt a debugger source map: replace the generic diagram with an order-specific map linking illustrated partitions to destinations, emphasizing short-partition endpoints and orientation.
openings.delta: Source-to-runtime correspondence becomes part-to-slot correspondence. Failed correspondence: software locations are discrete; physical insertion also involves stiffness, friction and technique. Changed material assumptions: customers must recognize silhouettes without digital identifiers; placement information cannot correct mechanical fit.
openings.prediction: A placement-information cause predicts fewer destination questions and wrong-slot attempts, even if correctly targeted second insertion attempts persist.
openings.probe: Assign five participants per diagram condition, balanced across layouts. Record unaided arrangement success, destination questions, wrong-slot attempts and correct-slot retries. Keep parts identical; price preparation and printing. Treat this comparison as screening, then verify all pilot targets.
assumptions: Order-specific maps can be prepared within budget and deadline.
Diagram recognition transfers to customers without restricting later rearrangement.
